# FilmSnaps

> FilmSnaps is a privacy-first streaming-discovery app for movies and TV shows. It does not host content — it links to third-party streaming providers' embed pages inside a sandboxed WebView, blocking ads and trackers at the network level. Everything (watch history, saved titles, downloads, settings) stays on the user's device.

- [Home — trending movies & TV shows](https://filmsnap-pro.netlify.app/)

## Facts

- FilmSnaps is an open-source project. The repository is at https://github.com/anonymous260260a-arch/filmsnaps
- Content metadata (posters, backdrops, ratings, cast) is provided by The Movie Database (TMDB).
- The desktop app is built with Electron; the web app with Next.js; the mobile app with React Native (Expo).
- FilmSnaps blocks ads and trackers using a layered system: a native network-level engine (Aho-Corasick pattern matching over EasyList/EasyPrivacy/AdGuard-derived lists), cosmetic CSS filtering, runtime guard scripts, anti-anti-adblock scriptlets, and provider-specific rules.
